text: DBIM SCHEME PAGES PUT EACH PART WHERE A READER LOOKS FOR IT, AND THE RAIL IS APPLY NOW AND A LIST OF THE PAGE. The live pages file content under whatever heading was to hand — PM-DAKSH's About is its application steps and required documents, NOS's Benefits ends with its documents and dates, Pre-Matric's About holds its conditions of eligibility. sortTopics (lib/website-dbim/prose.ts, with tests) moves each labelled part — eligibility, benefits, required documents, timelines, how to apply, and a numbered list that opens with Register/Apply/Visit — to its own section, its words and label kept. Application Process reads Where to Apply (alternatives, bulleted) → Steps to Apply → Required Documents → Important Timelines. The rail drops the name card that repeated the page title and the How to Apply box: it is one filled Apply Now, labelled just that (its destination read to assistive technology), and On This Page, built from the same list as the page so it cannot name a section the page does not show.
